sentences.en: Islam is grossly misrepresented in the West.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰教在西方被严重歪曲。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, many of the popular science articles written about the study misrepresented its conclusions.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，许多关于这项研究的流行科学文章误称了其结论。

sentences.en: The politician was accused of misrepresenting his opponent's policies to gain votes.
sentences.zh: 这位政客因曲解对手的政策以获取选票而遭到指责。
